lines: 💛 You hold Seed packet. Pressed into your hand with an order: keep people fed through winter. Seeds are a plan. Plans are how you stop being helpless. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. (The next feast grants FEASTED until tomorrow's dawn: strikes & abilities uplifted, devotion ×1.5 — richer feasts hit harder.)
Travel 1 tile to creek.
Something pads into the clearing — The Herald. It's here.
You catch fragments by the fire — Grace telling Valeria about Zhazira. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.
The creek runs fast here — no crossing without a bridge or a swim.
Travel 2 tiles to grove.
It followed you. The Herald is here.
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.
Travel 1 tile to Haven.
The Herald stops at the boundary — pacing, unwilling. Something else is already here. It's still out there.
While you were gone — one thing you missed:
🩸 The Highbeam Deer mauled Eduardo (-66 health) over 2 rounds. They're lucky to be breathing.
You keep a day's food (1985 kcal) and unload 450 kcal into Haven's pantry.
You walk back into Haven. 69 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.
You settle into the hall floor. Sleep takes you.
💧 Ingrid returns with water: +2 clean.
🚶 Valeria is back with Ingrid.
🌾 Nothing comes from Emberhold this week — their fields are as empty as the wagons look. Hunger isn't defiance, but the ledger doesn't know the difference. (Arrears +1,688 kcal, trust -2.)
🌾 Nothing comes from Stonebridge this week — their fields are as empty as the wagons look. Hunger isn't defiance, but the ledger doesn't know the difference. (Arrears +1,688 kcal, trust -2.)
🌾 Tribute from Thornfield arrives — 1,688 kcal of grain into the pantry. Their fields, our fire.
🌙 Night. Shouts from the treeline — Priya of The Hungry Road II with 4 others, and they're not here to talk. "Your pantry or your blood. Choose." (They want ~2,000 kcal.)
📓 Codex: Priya of The Hungry Road II raids Haven's treeline — demands ~2,000 kcal.
🚶 Lucas Brown walks in — pack light, eyes wide. Haven grows by one. (9 souls.)
🚶 a lean hunter walks in — pack light, eyes wide. Haven grows by one. (10 souls.)
Valeria stared at their hands for a long time today. Something is changing.

🌙 Night. The lingering The Herald gorges at the treeline — 1,000 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.

🌙 Night. The lingering The Congregation gorges at the treeline — 1,850 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
Village meal: +2666 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry.
Nadia came back with an armful of something edible, unprompted. (+100 kcal pantry)
Lucas came back with 504 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
Eduardo is hurt — a fall, a thorn, a bad step. (health 48/100)
Lucas and Tashi lingered over the fire together.
🍽️ Grace leaves the foraging basket at the door. "The pantry can't take more — sitting with the elders instead."
🍽️ Grace sets the sharing basket down by the fire instead of the pantry. "Full shelves don't need my little more."
🌿 Sweet Manioc — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 Sweet Manioc: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
💧 The cistern won't cover today — the hall's call, no vote needed: half rations until the water runs come back.
The land is getting tired. The easy food is thinning.
🌪️ THE HERALD struck Emberhold in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)
— DAY 120 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
👀 Ingrid let a place-name slip — somewhere that isn't Denver — then covered it with "Denver" so fast the cover was louder than the slip.
💬 Noah says: "They said you're doing well. It sounded... proud? Can they feel proud?"
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from Emberhold bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Feared. The show's narration lingers on your hands.
📊 THE STANDINGS — Haven sits 1st of 7. Haven leads. The audience has a favorite, and it's you.
🔥 Tashi says it at the fire, not quite looking at Lucas: “Your past story doesn’t add up. Someone had to say it.” The fire goes quiet in the way it does when someone’s decided to be brave.
Something has shifted. Conversations stop when you approach the fire. Nobody meets your eyes for long.
Dawn. You wake rested. (+0 health, energy restored. By the fire. Good enough.)
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
Grace left 2 branches by the stash. No announcement. That's how it works here.
📯 It moves.
You catch fragments by the fire — Grace telling Lucas about Valeria. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.
You catch fragments by the fire — Ingrid telling Nikodem about Tashi. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.
You catch fragments by the fire — Nadia telling Nikodem about herself. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.
You catch fragments by the fire — Nadia telling Lucas about Ingrid. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.
You catch fragments by the fire — Zhazira telling Nikodem about herself. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.
You catch fragments by the fire — Grace telling Nikodem about Valeria. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.
You catch fragments by the fire — Valeria telling Grace about Tashi. The story's getting bigger than what happened.
💬 Grace says: "Do you ever feel it? Like the air leans in when something happens."
👥 Valeria heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin."
👥 Ingrid walks out with Valeria. "Nobody walks alone today."
Tashi heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits."
💬 Lucas has been asking you about Berserker Rage — what it does, what it goes with. Planning something.
Nikodem heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
Its posture changes. Curiosity is over.

🚶 Eduardo is back with Nadia.

👥 Eduardo walks out with Nadia. "Nobody walks alone today."

👥 Tashi walks out with Lucas. "Nobody walks alone today."

Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
